quote:
We have
several multi-year software as a service agreements with Oracle, principally for finance and human resources, as
well as software support agreements and database licenses used by various applications. During the three and six
months ended June 30, 2026, we made payments to Oracle totaling $44 million and $46 million, respectively.

February 2026, we executed a six-year cloud infrastructure services agreement with Oracle with a total
commitment of $300 million, under which payments escalate over the term, in connection with our anticipated
